facts.text: Composite character-reference sheet for a dark fantasy dragon: a wide cinematic hero image across the top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle row, and four detail close-ups in the bottom row.

The subject is a massive quadrupedal dragon with near-black, overlapping scales, long pale bone-colored horns swept back from the skull, a spiked dorsal ridge, large membranous wings, a long spiked tail, and large curved claws.

In the top hero panel the dragon stands in a low quadrupedal stance with its head lowered over wet, rocky ground; jagged dark mountains and glowing orange lava or ember light appear in the background.
The middle-left panel is a frontal full-body view of the dragon with wings spread, labeled FRONT.
The middle-center panel is a side-profile full-body view with one wing extended, labeled SIDE PROFILE.
The middle-right panel is a rear full-body view with wings spread, labeled REAR.
The bottom-left close-up shows the dragon’s head, including an amber-orange eye, textured facial scales, and the bases of the long ivory horns; it is labeled HEAD CLOSE.
The second bottom-row panel isolates a dark, veined wing membrane stretched over bony supports; it is labeled WING MEMBRANE.
The third bottom-row panel is a close view of a scaled foot with several large, curved dark claws; it is labeled CLAW AND FOOT.
The bottom-right panel is an extreme close-up of overlapping dark scales with subtle blue-gray highlights; it is labeled SCALE DETAIL.
Visible labels in pale uppercase sans-serif text are FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The overall style is highly detailed dark-fantasy creature concept art with cinematic, photorealistic rendering, low-key lighting, cool blue-gray highlights, and warm orange ember accents.
